assumptions.sessions: Two equal sessions per day, at elapsed 00:00 and 12:00. No warm-up, gifts, administrator overrides or clock acceleration. Day N snapshots are taken before the next day's login.
assumptions.decisions: At most one intent per 5 seconds. Read/automatic settlement before each intent. Priorities and resource reserves are deterministic heuristics, not an optimal strategy.
assumptions.production: Manual queue limit 3; enable automatic prepaid queue limit 30 in last 30 seconds of each session; disable on next login. Pending jobs remain stored when warehouse is full. Automatic settlement order is fixed building creation order instead of random UUID order.
assumptions.storage: Actual base capacity + one warehouse upgraded to level 3; no unlimited warehouse. No extra floor needed for at most 8 buildings on the 9 original tiles. Explicit discard is a recorded sink.
assumptions.rng: Five fixed seeds, uniform salvage selection and actual pure exploration engine. Production outcomes and choices are not rerolled. Candidate selection uses displayed probability, never hidden outcome.
assumptions.orders: Only three simultaneous player orders, real oldest-issued template rotation, actual 30 minute expiry, level gates, same inputs/coins/xp as seed configuration. Model refreshes at each active 5 second tick.
assumptions.absent: No reads, recurring production refill, salvage claims, event decisions or reward claims while offline; only already prepaid jobs and dispatched voyage timestamps advance.
assumptions.market: Zero trades: no asserted clearing prices or synthetic buyer demand. 5% fee is analyzed separately.
assumptions.scope: No residents, housing consumption, specialties, new multi-step processing chains, weather or cooperative rewards exist in this model; they are not yet implemented. Existing cabin has only prosperity, no resident upkeep.
assumptions.limitations: Strategy model only; not live server measurements, API performance, retention forecast or equilibrium proof. Low-level timing matches configuration but network latency, human learning and failed HTTP requests are excluded. Administrative recipe overrides excluded.
